slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Sector area = (arc measure/360) times πr2. Segment area = sector area minus the area of the triangle formed by the two radii and the chord.

A sector is a "pizza slice"; a circular segment is the region between a chord and its arc. For a 90 degree sector of radius 6: sector area = (1/4)(36π) = 9π; the triangle has area (1/2)(6)(6) = 18; the segment has area 9π − 18, about 10.3.
